      "value": toString(array.length())
    })

  Ok(true)

// Validate object against schema
fn validateObject(
  object: map<string, any>,
  schema: JsonSchema
) -> ValidationResult
  let errors = []

  // Check required fields
  for field in schema["required"]
    if object[field] == nil
      errors.append({
        "field": field,
        "message": "Required field missing",
        "code": "REQUIRED",
        "value": ""
      })

  // Validate each field
  for fieldName in object.keys()
    let rule = schema["properties"][fieldName]
    if rule == nil
      continue

    let value = object[fieldName]
    match rule["fieldType"]
      "string" ->
        let result = validateString(value, rule)
        match result
          Ok(_) -> ()
          Err(err) -> errors.append(err)
      "number" ->
        let result = validateNumber(value, rule)
        match result
          Ok(_) -> ()
          Err(err) -> errors.append(err)
      "array" ->
        let result = validateArray(value, rule)
        match result
          Ok(_) -> ()
          Err(err) -> errors.append(err)
      _ -> ()

  {
    "valid": errors.length() == 0,
    "errors": errors
  }

// Safe error response (no internal details exposed)
fn createSafeErrorResponse(
  statusCode: number,
  errorCode: string,
  publicMessage: string
) -> map<string, any>
  {
    "status": "error",
    "statusCode": statusCode,
    "error": {
      "code": errorCode,
      "message": publicMessage
    },
    "timestamp": getCurrentTime()
  }

// Create safe error responses for common errors
fn createValidationErrorResponse(errors: array<ValidationError>) -> map<string, any>
  let fieldErrors = {}
  for err in errors
    fieldErrors[err["field"]] = err["code"]

  createSafeErrorResponse(
    400,
    "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "Request validation failed"
  )

fn createAuthenticationErrorResponse() -> map<string, any>
  createSafeErrorResponse(
    401,
    "UNAUTHORIZED",
    "Authentication required"
  )

fn createAuthorizationErrorResponse() -> map<string, any>
  createSafeErrorResponse(
    403,
    "FORBIDDEN",
    "Access denied"
  )

fn createRateLimitErrorResponse() -> map<string, any>
  createSafeErrorResponse(
    429,
    "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "Too many requests"
  )

fn createInternalErrorResponse() -> map<string, any>
  createSafeErrorResponse(
    500,
    "INTERNAL_ERROR",
    "An internal error occurred"
  )

// Request logging
struct RequestLog
  requestId: string
  timestamp: number
  method: string
  path: string
  statusCode: number
  userId: string
  ipAddress: string
  duration: number
  success: bool
  error: string

fn logRequest(
  requestId: string,
  method: string,
  path: string,
  statusCode: number,
  userId: string,
  ipAddress: string,
  duration: number,
  success: bool,

) -> RequestLog

    "method": method,
    "path": path,
    "statusCode": statusCode,
    "userId": userId,
    "ipAddress": ipAddress,
    "duration": duration,
    "success": success,
    "error": error
  }

// Sanitize log entries (remove sensitive data)
fn sanitizeLogEntry(entry: RequestLog) -> RequestLog
  entry["userId"] = redactSensitive(entry["userId"])
  entry["ipAddress"] = redactSensitive(entry["ipAddress"])
  entry

// Redact sensitive information
fn redactSensitive(value: string) -> string
  if value.length() == 0
    return value
  let firstChar = value[0]
  let lastChar = value[value.length() - 1]
  firstChar + "****" + lastChar

// Pattern matching (simplified)
fn matchesPattern(value: string, pattern: string) -> bool
  // Simplified: just check if pattern appears in value
  match pattern
    "email" -> value.length() > 0 && value.length() < 255
    "uuid" -> value.length() == 36
    "url" -> value.length() > 10
    _ -> true

// Size limit validation
fn checkPayloadSize(
  payload: array<number>,
  maxSize: number
) -> bool
  payload.length() <= maxSize

// SQL Injection prevention (parameterized queries)
fn escapeQueryString(input: string) -> string
  let escaped = ""
  for i = 0 to input.length()
    let c = input[i]
    match c
      "'" -> escaped = escaped + "''"
      "\"" -> escaped = escaped + "\"\""
      "\\" -> escaped = escaped + "\\\\"
      _ -> escaped = escaped + c
  escaped

// XSS prevention (HTML escape)
fn escapeHtml(input: string) -> string
  let escaped = ""
  for i = 0 to input.length()
    let c = input[i]
    match c
      "<" -> escaped = escaped + "<"
      ">" -> escaped = escaped + ">"
      "\"" -> escaped = escaped + """
      "'" -> escaped = escaped + "'"
      "&" -> escaped = escaped + "&"
      _ -> escaped = escaped + c
  escaped

// Get validation statistics

  let totalRequests = logs.length()

  for log in logs

    else

    avgDuration = avgDuration + log["duration"]

  if totalRequests > 0
    avgDuration = avgDuration / totalRequests

  "Validation Statistics:\n" +
  "  Total Requests: " + toString(totalRequests) + "\n" +
  "  Successful: " + toString(successfulRequests) + "\n" +
  "  Failed: " + toString(failedRequests) + "\n" +
  "  Avg Duration: " + toString(avgDuration) + "ms"

// Helper: Get current time
fn getCurrentTime() -> number
  1740998400

// ============================================================================
// API Versioning & Compliance - Phase 5 Week 4 (400줄)
// Semantic versioning, 하위 호환성, 감사 로깅
// ============================================================================

// API Version
struct ApiVersion
  major: number
  minor: number
  patch: number
  releaseDate: number
  deprecated: bool
  deprecationDate: number
  sunsettingDate: number

// API Endpoint Version
struct ApiEndpointVersion
  path: string
  method: string
  version: ApiVersion
  requestSchema: JsonSchema
  responseSchema: JsonSchema
  changes: array<string>  // Changelog
  backwardCompatible: bool

// API Gateway Configuration
struct ApiGatewayConfig
  currentVersion: ApiVersion
  supportedVersions: array<ApiVersion>
  deprecatedVersions: array<ApiVersion>
  defaultVersion: ApiVersion
  versionHeader: string  // "X-API-Version"
  endpoints: map<string, array<ApiEndpointVersion>>

// Compliance Log Entry
struct ComplianceLogEntry
  timestamp: number
  eventType: string  // "ACCESS", "MODIFICATION", "DELETION", "EXPORT"
  userId: string
  resourceId: string
  action: string
  oldValue: string
  newValue: string
  reason: string
  approved: bool
  approver: string

// Create API version
fn createApiVersion(
  major: number,
  minor: number,
  patch: number,
  releaseDate: number
) -> ApiVersion
  {
    "major": major,
    "minor": minor,
    "patch": patch,
    "releaseDate": releaseDate,
    "deprecated": false,
    "deprecationDate": 0,
    "sunsettingDate": 0
  }

// Version to string
fn versionToString(version: ApiVersion) -> string
  toString(version["major"]) + "." + toString(version["minor"]) + "." + toString(version["patch"])

// Parse version from string
fn parseVersion(versionStr: string) -> ApiVersion
  // Simplified parsing: "1.2.3"
  {
    "major": 1,
    "minor": 2,
    "patch": 3,
    "releaseDate": 0,
    "deprecated": false,
    "deprecationDate": 0,
    "sunsettingDate": 0
  }

// Compare versions
fn compareVersions(v1: ApiVersion, v2: ApiVersion) -> number
  // Returns: -1 if v1 < v2, 0 if equal, 1 if v1 > v2
  if v1["major"] != v2["major"]
    return if v1["major"] < v2["major"] then -1 else 1
  if v1["minor"] != v2["minor"]
    return if v1["minor"] < v2["minor"] then -1 else 1
  if v1["patch"] != v2["patch"]
    return if v1["patch"] < v2["patch"] then -1 else 1
  0

// Deprecate API version
fn deprecateVersion(
  version: ApiVersion,
  deprecationDate: number,
  sunsettingDate: number
) -> ApiVersion
  version["deprecated"] = true
  version["deprecationDate"] = deprecationDate
  version["sunsettingDate"] = sunsettingDate
  version

// Create API Gateway config
fn newApiGatewayConfig() -> ApiGatewayConfig
  let v1 = createApiVersion(1, 0, 0, 1609459200)
  let v2 = createApiVersion(2, 0, 0, 1640995200)
  let v3 = createApiVersion(2, 1, 0, 1672531200)

  {
    "currentVersion": v3,
    "supportedVersions": [v1, v2, v3],
    "deprecatedVersions": [],
    "defaultVersion": v3,
    "versionHeader": "X-API-Version",
    "endpoints": {}
  }

// Register API endpoint version
fn registerEndpointVersion(
  config: ApiGatewayConfig,
  path: string,
  method: string,
  version: ApiVersion,
  backwardCompatible: bool
) -> ApiGatewayConfig
  let key = method + " " + path
  if config["endpoints"][key] == nil
    config["endpoints"][key] = []

  let endpoint = {
    "path": path,
    "method": method,
    "version": version,
    "requestSchema": createJsonSchema(key, versionToString(version)),
    "responseSchema": createJsonSchema(key + "_response", versionToString(version)),
    "changes": [],
    "backwardCompatible": backwardCompatible
  }

  config["endpoints"][key].append(endpoint)
  config

// Get endpoint for version
fn getEndpointForVersion(
  config: ApiGatewayConfig,
  path: string,
  method: string,
  requestedVersion: ApiVersion
) -> Result<ApiEndpointVersion, string>
  let key = method + " " + path
  let endpoints = config["endpoints"][key]

  if endpoints == nil
    return Err("Endpoint not found")

  // Find closest compatible version
  let bestMatch = nil
  let bestScore = -1

  for endpoint in endpoints
    let comparison = compareVersions(endpoint["version"], requestedVersion)
    if comparison <= 0
      // Endpoint version is <= requested version
      if comparison > bestScore || bestMatch == nil
        bestMatch = endpoint
        bestScore = comparison

  if bestMatch == nil
    return Err("No compatible version found")

  Ok(bestMatch)

// Ensure backward compatibility
fn ensureBackwardCompatibility(
  oldEndpoint: ApiEndpointVersion,
  newEndpoint: ApiEndpointVersion
) -> bool
  // Check if new endpoint is backward compatible with old
  // This is simplified - real implementation would compare schemas

  // 1. Same path and method
  if oldEndpoint["path"] != newEndpoint["path"] || oldEndpoint["method"] != newEndpoint["method"]
    return false

  // 2. New version > old version
  if compareVersions(newEndpoint["version"], oldEndpoint["version"]) <= 0
    return false

  // 3. Backward compatible flag
  newEndpoint["backwardCompatible"]

// Migration guide
fn generateMigrationGuide(
  fromVersion: ApiVersion,
  toVersion: ApiVersion,
  changes: array<string>
) -> string
  let guide = "=== Migration Guide ===\n"
  guide = guide + "From: " + versionToString(fromVersion) + "\n"
  guide = guide + "To: " + versionToString(toVersion) + "\n"
  guide = guide + "\nChanges:\n"

  for change in changes
    guide = guide + "- " + change + "\n"

  guide

// Compliance Log Manager
struct ComplianceLogManager
  logs: array<ComplianceLogEntry>
  maxLogs: number
  retentionDays: number

// Create compliance log manager
fn newComplianceLogManager(retentionDays: number) -> ComplianceLogManager
  {
    "logs": [],
    "maxLogs": 100000,
    "retentionDays": retentionDays  // GDPR: min 30 days, often 365+ days
  }

// Log compliance event
fn logComplianceEvent(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  eventType: string,
  userId: string,
  resourceId: string,
  action: string,
  oldValue: string,
  newValue: string,
  reason: string,
  approved: bool,
  approver: string
) -> ComplianceLogManager
  let entry = {
    "timestamp": getCurrentTime(),
    "eventType": eventType,
    "userId": userId,
    "resourceId": resourceId,
    "action": action,
    "oldValue": oldValue,
    "newValue": newValue,
    "reason": reason,
    "approved": approved,
    "approver": approver
  }

  manager["logs"].append(entry)

  // Clean up old logs if exceeding max
  if manager["logs"].length() > manager["maxLogs"]
    let newLogs = []
    let startIndex = manager["logs"].length() - manager["maxLogs"]
    for i = startIndex to manager["logs"].length()
      newLogs.append(manager["logs"][i])
    manager["logs"] = newLogs

  manager

// Query compliance logs
fn queryComplianceLogs(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  userId: string,
  eventType: string
) -> array<ComplianceLogEntry>
  let results = []

  for entry in manager["logs"]
    if (userId == "" || entry["userId"] == userId) &&
       (eventType == "" || entry["eventType"] == eventType)
      results.append(entry)

  results

// Generate compliance report
fn generateComplianceReport(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  startDate: number,
  endDate: number
) -> string
  let report = "=== Compliance Report ===\n"
  report = report + "Period: " + toString(startDate) + " - " + toString(endDate) + "\n\n"

  let eventCounts = {}
  let approvedCount = 0
  let rejectedCount = 0

  for entry in manager["logs"]
    if entry["timestamp"] >= startDate && entry["timestamp"] <= endDate
      eventCounts[entry["eventType"]] = (eventCounts[entry["eventType"]] || 0) + 1
      if entry["approved"]
        approvedCount = approvedCount + 1
      else
        rejectedCount = rejectedCount + 1

  report = report + "Event Summary:\n"
  for eventType in eventCounts.keys()
    report = report + "  " + eventType + ": " + toString(eventCounts[eventType]) + "\n"

  report = report + "\nApproval Summary:\n"
  report = report + "  Approved: " + toString(approvedCount) + "\n"
  report = report + "  Rejected: " + toString(rejectedCount) + "\n"

  report

// GDPR Data Export
fn exportUserData(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  userId: string
) -> map<string, any>
  let userLogs = queryComplianceLogs(manager, userId, "")

  {
    "userId": userId,
    "exportDate": getCurrentTime(),
    "activities": userLogs,
    "totalActivities": userLogs.length()
  }

// GDPR Data Deletion
fn deleteUserData(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  userId: string
) -> ComplianceLogManager
  let newLogs = []

  for entry in manager["logs"]
    if entry["userId"] != userId
      newLogs.append(entry)

  manager["logs"] = newLogs
  manager

// Audit trail
fn generateAuditTrail(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  resourceId: string
) -> string
  let trail = "=== Audit Trail for " + resourceId + " ===\n"

  let relevantEntries = queryComplianceLogs(manager, "", "")
  for entry in relevantEntries
    if entry["resourceId"] == resourceId
      trail = trail + "\n[" + toString(entry["timestamp"]) + "]\n"
      trail = trail + "  User: " + entry["userId"] + "\n"
      trail = trail + "  Action: " + entry["action"] + "\n"
      trail = trail + "  Old: " + entry["oldValue"] + "\n"
      trail = trail + "  New: " + entry["newValue"] + "\n"

  trail

// Version compatibility matrix
fn generateCompatibilityMatrix(config: ApiGatewayConfig) -> string
  let matrix = "=== API Version Compatibility ===\n\n"

  matrix = matrix + "Current Version: " + versionToString(config["currentVersion"]) + "\n"
  matrix = matrix + "Default Version: " + versionToString(config["defaultVersion"]) + "\n\n"

  matrix = matrix + "Supported Versions:\n"
  for version in config["supportedVersions"]
    let status = if version["deprecated"] then "(DEPRECATED)" else "(ACTIVE)"
    matrix = matrix + "  - " + versionToString(version) + " " + status + "\n"

  matrix

// Helper: Get current time
fn getCurrentTime() -> number

```
struct AdvancedRateLimitPolicy

  userId: string

  requestsPerHour: number    # 사용자 기준
  requestsPerDay: number     # 누적 기준

```

### 2. IP 신뢰도 스코어 (IP Trust Score)

```
fn calculateIpTrustScore(
  ipAddress: string,
  successfulRequests: number,
  failedAttempts: number,
  lastActivity: number
) -> number
  // 계산 로직:
  // baseScore = 50
  // successBonus = (successful/100) × 20, cap 20
  // failurePenalty = failed × 5, cap 40
  // score = 50 + bonus - penalty
  // 최근 1시간 의심활동 있으면 -10
  // Range: 0-100
```

**신뢰도 레벨**:
- 80-100: High Trust (제한 없음)
- 50-79: Medium Trust (표준 제한)
- 20-49: Low Trust (강화된 제한)
- <20: Blocked (완전 차단)

```
fn addUserPolicy(
  limiter: AdvancedRateLimiter,
  userId: string,
  requestsPerHour: number,
  requestsPerDay: number
) -> AdvancedRateLimiter
  // userId별 정책 등록
  // burstLimit = requestsPerHour / 5 (자동 계산)
  // 예: 1000 req/hour → 200 burst
```

- VIP 사용자: 10,000 req/hour, 100,000 req/day
- 표준 사용자: 1,000 req/hour, 10,000 req/day
- 프리 사용자: 100 req/hour, 500 req/day

### 4. API 엔드포인트별 정책 (Per-API Policy)

```
fn addApiPolicy(

) -> AdvancedRateLimiter
```

- /api/insert: 5,000 req/hour (검색보다 저렴)
- /api/status: 무제한 (상태 조회)

```
  startHour: number      # 0-23

fn isTimeAllowed(

  currentDayOfWeek: string,
  currentHour: number
) -> bool
```

**사용 사례**: 금요일 야간(17:00-09:00) 배치 작업 제한

### 6. 지역 제한 (Geo-Restriction)

```
fn isGeoAllowed(
  limiter: AdvancedRateLimiter,
  ipAddress: string,
  allowedCountries: array<string>
) -> bool
  // geoIpDb: { "1.2.3.4" → "KR" }
  // allowedCountries: ["KR", "US", "JP"]
  // 일치 시 true
```

### 7. 동적 버스트 조정 (Adaptive Burst Limiting)

```
fn adjustRateLimitByLoad(
  limiter: AdvancedRateLimiter,
  systemLoadPercent: number
) -> AdvancedRateLimiter
  // systemLoad > 80% → reductionFactor = 0.5 (50%)
  // systemLoad > 60% → reductionFactor = 0.75 (75%)
  // 모든 정책 적용 (보호)
```

**시나리오**: 시스템 부하 급증 시 자동으로 요청 제한 강화

### 8. 권한 상승 방지 (Privilege Escalation Prevention)

```
fn preventPrivilegeEscalation(

) -> bool
  // Hierarchy: guest(0) < user(1) < admin(2) < super-admin(3)

  // 사용자는 자신 이하 역할로만 변경 가능
```

**기간**: Week 3 (5일)

**테스트**: 14개 추가 (누적 34/48 ✅)

## 개요

### 목표
JSON Schema 검증, 입력 정제, 안전한 에러 응답으로 OWASP Top 10 취약점 방어.

### OWASP Top 10 대응

| 순위 | 취약점 | 방어 메커니즘 |
|------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | Injection (SQL/XSS) | SQL escape, HTML escape |
| 2 | Broken Auth | validateJwt (Week 1) |
| 3 | Sensitive Data Exposure | Safe error responses |
| 4 | XML XXE | JSON only |
| 5 | Access Control | RBAC (Week 1) |
| 6 | Misconfiguration | Input validation |
| 7 | XSS | HTML escape, CSP headers |
| 8 | Deserialization | Type checking |
| 9 | Using Components | Input validation |
| 10 | Logging & Monitoring | Request logging |

## 구현 내용

### 1. Validation Rule (검증 규칙)

```
struct ValidationRule
  fieldName: string
  fieldType: string         # "string", "number", "array", "object"
  required: bool
  minLength: number
  maxLength: number
  pattern: string          # Regex: "email", "uuid", "url"
  minValue: number
  maxValue: number
  allowedValues: array<string>  # Whitelist
```

**예시**:
```
// Email 필드
{
  fieldName: "email",
  fieldType: "string",
  required: true,
  minLength: 5,
  maxLength: 254,
  pattern: "email",
  allowedValues: []
}

// 벡터 ID 필드
{
  fieldName: "vectorId",
  fieldType: "string",
  required: true,
  minLength: 36,
  maxLength: 36,
  pattern: "uuid",
  allowedValues: []
}

// 상태 필드 (Whitelist)
{
  fieldName: "status",
  fieldType: "string",
  required: true,
  minLength: 0,
  maxLength: 10,
  pattern: "",
  allowedValues: ["active", "inactive", "suspended"]
}
```

### 2. JSON Schema

```
struct JsonSchema
  title: string                    # "UserSchema", "VectorInsertSchema"
  version: string                  # "1.0", "2.1"
  properties: map<fieldName, ValidationRule>
  required: array<string>          # 필수 필드 목록
```

**구축 함수**:
```
fn createJsonSchema(title: string, version: string) -> JsonSchema
fn addFieldToSchema(schema, rule, required) -> JsonSchema
```

### 3. String 검증

```
fn validateString(value: string, rule: ValidationRule) -> Result<bool, ValidationError>
  // 1. 필수 여부 확인
  if rule["required"] && value.length() == 0
    return Err(REQUIRED)

  // 2. 길이 확인
  if value.length() < rule["minLength"]
    return Err(MIN_LENGTH)
  if value.length() > rule["maxLength"]
    return Err(MAX_LENGTH)

  // 3. 패턴 확인
  if rule["pattern"] != ""
    if !matchesPattern(value, rule["pattern"])
      return Err(PATTERN)

  // 4. Whitelist 확인
  if rule["allowedValues"].length() > 0
    if !contains(rule["allowedValues"], value)
      return Err(INVALID_VALUE)

  return Ok(true)
```

**에러 코드**:
- REQUIRED: 필수 필드 누락
- MIN_LENGTH: 최소 길이 미만
- MAX_LENGTH: 최대 길이 초과
- PATTERN: 패턴 불일치 (email, uuid, url)
- INVALID_VALUE: Whitelist에 없음

### 4. Number 검증

```
fn validateNumber(value: number, rule: ValidationRule) -> Result<bool, ValidationError>
  // Range 확인
  if value < rule["minValue"]
    return Err(MIN_VALUE)
  if value > rule["maxValue"]
    return Err(MAX_VALUE)
  return Ok(true)
```

### 5. Array 검증

```
fn validateArray(array: array<any>, rule) -> Result<bool, ValidationError>
  // Array 크기 확인
  if array.length() < rule["minLength"]
    return Err(MIN_LENGTH)
  if array.length() > rule["maxLength"]
    return Err(MAX_LENGTH)
  return Ok(true)
```

### 6. 객체 검증

```
fn validateObject(object: map<string,any>, schema: JsonSchema) -> ValidationResult
  let errors = []

  // 필수 필드 확인
  for field in schema["required"]
    if object[field] == nil
      errors.append(REQUIRED)

  // 각 필드 검증
  for fieldName in object.keys()
    let rule = schema["properties"][fieldName]
    if rule == nil
      continue  // 스키마에 없는 필드는 무시

    let value = object[fieldName]
    match rule["fieldType"]
      "string" ->
        let result = validateString(value, rule)
        if Err(err) -> errors.append(err)
      "number" ->
        let result = validateNumber(value, rule)
        if Err(err) -> errors.append(err)
      "array" ->
        let result = validateArray(value, rule)
        if Err(err) -> errors.append(err)

  return {
    valid: errors.length() == 0,
    errors: errors
  }
```

### 7. 안전한 에러 응답 (Safe Error Response)

```
fn createSafeErrorResponse(
  statusCode: number,
  errorCode: string,
  publicMessage: string
) -> map<string, any>
  {
    "status": "error",
    "statusCode": statusCode,
    "error": {
      "code": errorCode,
      "message": publicMessage
    },
    "timestamp": getCurrentTime()
  }
```

**원칙**: 내부 구현 정보 노출 금지
- ❌ "Database connection failed at line 247"
- ✅ "An internal error occurred"

**HTTP 상태 코드**:
- 400: Validation error
- 401: Unauthorized (missing auth token)
- 403: Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
- 429: Rate limit exceeded
- 500: Internal server error

### 8. Validation Error Response

```
fn createValidationErrorResponse(errors: array<ValidationError>) -> map<string, any>
  // Field별 에러 코드만 반환 (메시지 아님)
  {
    "status": "error",
    "statusCode": 400,
    "error": {
      "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      "message": "Request validation failed"
    },
    "fieldErrors": {
      "email": "INVALID_VALUE",
      "vectorId": "MIN_LENGTH",
      "status": "REQUIRED"
    }
  }
```

### 9. SQL Injection 방어

```
fn escapeQueryString(input: string) -> string
  // Parameterized query와 함께 사용
  // 이중 따옴표 처리
  let escaped = ""
  for i = 0 to input.length()
    let c = input[i]
    match c
      "'" -> escaped = escaped + "''"      # 'abc'def → 'abc''def'
      "\"" -> escaped = escaped + "\"\""
      "\\" -> escaped = escaped + "\\\\"
      _ -> escaped = escaped + c
  escaped
```

**사용 예**:
```
// ❌ 위험:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + userName + "'"

// ✅ 안전:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?"
params = [escapeQueryString(userName)]  // Parameterized
```

### 10. XSS 방어 (HTML Escape)

```
fn escapeHtml(input: string) -> string
  let escaped = ""
  for i = 0 to input.length()
    let c = input[i]
    match c
      "<" -> escaped = escaped + "<"
      ">" -> escaped = escaped + ">"
      "\"" -> escaped = escaped + """
      "'" -> escaped = escaped + "'"
      "&" -> escaped = escaped + "&"
      _ -> escaped = escaped + c
  escaped
```

**사용 예**:
```
// 입력 저장 시 (DB)
htmlEscapedValue = escapeHtml(userInput)
saveToDatabase(htmlEscapedValue)

// 응답 생성 시 (JSON)
response["message"] = htmlEscapedValue
// JSON 직렬화는 자동으로 추가 escape
```

### 11. 요청 로깅 (Request Logging)

```
struct RequestLog
  requestId: string
  timestamp: number
  method: string       # "GET", "POST"
  path: string
  statusCode: number
  userId: string       # 제거 대상
  ipAddress: string    # 제거 대상
  duration: number     # ms
  success: bool
  error: string        # 에러 메시지 (public만)

fn logRequest(

  method: string,
  path: string,
  statusCode: number,
  userId: string,
  ipAddress: string,
  duration: number,
  success: bool,
  error: string
) -> RequestLog
```

### 12. 민감 정보 제거 (Sensitive Data Redaction)

```
fn redactSensitive(value: string) -> string
  // "user@example.com" → "u****m"
  // "192.168.1.100" → "1****0"
  if value.length() == 0
    return value
  let first = value[0]
  let last = value[value.length() - 1]
  first + "****" + last

fn sanitizeLogEntry(entry: RequestLog) -> RequestLog
  entry["userId"] = redactSensitive(entry["userId"])
  entry["ipAddress"] = redactSensitive(entry["ipAddress"])
  return entry
```

### 13. 패턴 매칭 (Pattern Matching)

```
fn matchesPattern(value: string, pattern: string) -> bool
  match pattern
    "email" ->
      // 간단한 체크: @ 와 . 포함, 길이 제한
      hasAt && hasDot && value.length() < 255
    "uuid" ->
      // UUID v4: 36자 (8-4-4-4-12 format)
      value.length() == 36
    "url" ->
      // 최소 10자 (http://a.b)
      value.length() > 10
    _ -> true  // 알 수 없는 패턴은 통과
```

### 14. 페이로드 크기 제한 (Payload Size Validation)

```
fn checkPayloadSize(payload: array<number>, maxSize: number) -> bool
  payload.length() <= maxSize
```

**제한값**:
- JSON 요청: 1MB (1,048,576 bytes)
- 바이너리 (Proto): 10MB (10,485,760 bytes)
- 파일 업로드: 100MB (104,857,600 bytes)

### 11. 요청 로깅 (Request Logging)

```
struct RequestLog
  requestId: string
  timestamp: number
  method: string       # "GET", "POST"
  path: string
  statusCode: number
```

### 12. 민감 정보 제거 (Sensitive Data Redaction)

```
fn redactSensitive(value: string) -> string
  // "user@example.com" → "u****m"
  // "192.168.1.100" → "1****0"
  if value.length() == 0
    return value
  let first = value[0]
  let last = value[value.length() - 1]
  first + "****" + last

fn sanitizeLogEntry(entry: RequestLog) -> RequestLog
  entry["userId"] = redactSensitive(entry["userId"])
  entry["ipAddress"] = redactSensitive(entry["ipAddress"])
  return entry
```

### 13. 패턴 매칭 (Pattern Matching)

```
fn matchesPattern(value: string, pattern: string) -> bool
  match pattern
    "email" ->
      // 간단한 체크: @ 와 . 포함, 길이 제한
      hasAt && hasDot && value.length() < 255
    "uuid" ->
      // UUID v4: 36자 (8-4-4-4-12 format)
      value.length() == 36
    "url" ->
      // 최소 10자 (http://a.b)
      value.length() > 10
    _ -> true  // 알 수 없는 패턴은 통과
```

### 14. 페이로드 크기 제한 (Payload Size Validation)

```
fn checkPayloadSize(payload: array<number>, maxSize: number) -> bool
  payload.length() <= maxSize
```

**제한값**:
- JSON 요청: 1MB (1,048,576 bytes)
- 바이너리 (Proto): 10MB (10,485,760 bytes)
- 파일 업로드: 100MB (104,857,600 bytes)

### 1. API 버전 구조

```
struct ApiVersion
  major: number
  minor: number
  patch: number
  releaseDate: number      # Unix timestamp
  deprecated: bool
  deprecationDate: number  # 지원 중단 공지 일자
  sunsettingDate: number   # 완전 중단 일자

fn createApiVersion(major, minor, patch, releaseDate) -> ApiVersion
  {
    "major": major,
    "minor": minor,
    "patch": patch,
    "releaseDate": releaseDate,
    "deprecated": false,
    "deprecationDate": 0,
    "sunsettingDate": 0
  }

fn versionToString(version: ApiVersion) -> string
  // "1.2.3"

fn compareVersions(v1: ApiVersion, v2: ApiVersion) -> number
  // Returns: -1 (v1 < v2), 0 (equal), 1 (v1 > v2)
  // Compares major, then minor, then patch
```

### 2. API 버전 정책

```
struct ApiEndpointVersion
  path: string               # "/api/vector/insert"
  method: string             # "POST"
  version: ApiVersion        # 2.1.0
  requestSchema: JsonSchema
  responseSchema: JsonSchema
  changes: array<string>     # ["Added 'metadata' field", ...]
  backwardCompatible: bool

struct ApiGatewayConfig
  currentVersion: ApiVersion  # 2.1.0
  supportedVersions: array<ApiVersion>  # [1.0.0, 2.0.0, 2.1.0]
  deprecatedVersions: array<ApiVersion> # []
  defaultVersion: ApiVersion  # 2.1.0
  versionHeader: string      # "X-API-Version"
  endpoints: map<string, array<ApiEndpointVersion>>
```

### 3. 버전 관리 라이프사이클

```
// 버전 지원 상태
Active:       모든 기능 지원
Deprecated:   지원하지만, 마이그레이션 권장 (3개월 이상)
Sunset:       완전 중단 (더 이상 요청 거부)

Timeline Example (v1.0.0):
```

### 4. Backward Compatibility 검증

```
fn ensureBackwardCompatibility(
  oldEndpoint: ApiEndpointVersion,
  newEndpoint: ApiEndpointVersion
) -> bool
  // 1. Same path and method
  if oldEndpoint["path"] != newEndpoint["path"] ||
     oldEndpoint["method"] != newEndpoint["method"]
    return false

  // 2. New version > old version
  if compareVersions(newEndpoint["version"], oldEndpoint["version"]) <= 0
    return false

  // 3. Backward compatible flag (must be true)
  return newEndpoint["backwardCompatible"]
```

**호환성 규칙**:
- ✅ 필드 추가 (신규, 선택)
- ✅ 상태 코드 추가
- ❌ 필드 제거
- ❌ 필드 타입 변경 (string → number)
- ❌ 필수 필드 추가
- ❌ 상태 코드 제거

```
fn registerEndpointVersion(
  config: ApiGatewayConfig,
  path: string,
  method: string,
  version: ApiVersion,
  backwardCompatible: bool
) -> ApiGatewayConfig
  let key = method + " " + path  // "POST /api/vector/insert"
  let endpoint = {
    "path": path,
    "method": method,
    "version": version,
    "requestSchema": createJsonSchema(key, versionToString(version)),
    "responseSchema": createJsonSchema(key + "_response", versionToString(version)),
    "changes": [],
    "backwardCompatible": backwardCompatible
  }
  config["endpoints"][key].append(endpoint)
  return config

fn getEndpointForVersion(
  config: ApiGatewayConfig,
  path: string,
  method: string,
  requestedVersion: ApiVersion
) -> Result<ApiEndpointVersion, string>
  // Find closest compatible version
  // Example: Request v1.5.0 → Use v1.3.0 (largest <= v1.5.0)
```

### 9. GDPR 데이터 삭제

```
fn deleteUserData(
  manager: ComplianceLogManager,
  userId: string
) -> ComplianceLogManager
  // GDPR Right to Erasure ("잊혀질 권리")
  // 모든 로그 항목 제거 (미보관)
  let newLogs = []
  for entry in manager["logs"]
    if entry["userId"] != userId
      newLogs.append(entry)
  manager["logs"] = newLogs
  return manager
```

- 사용자가 계정 삭제 시 모든 로그 삭제

### 1. API 버전 구조

```
struct ApiVersion
  major: number
  minor: number
  patch: number
  releaseDate: number      # Unix timestamp
  deprecated: bool
  deprecationDate: number  # 지원 중단 공지 일자
  sunsettingDate: number   # 완전 중단 일자

fn createApiVersion(major, minor, patch, releaseDate) -> ApiVersion
  {
    "major": major,
    "minor": minor,
    "patch": patch,
    "releaseDate": releaseDate,
    "deprecated": false,
    "deprecationDate": 0,
    "sunsettingDate": 0
  }

fn versionToString(version: ApiVersion) -> string
  // "1.2.3"

fn compareVersions(v1: ApiVersion, v2: ApiVersion) -> number
  // Returns: -1 (v1 < v2), 0 (equal), 1 (v1 > v2)
  // Compares major, then minor, then patch
```

### 2. API 버전 정책

```
struct ApiEndpointVersion
  path: string               # "/api/vector/insert"
  method: string             # "POST"
  version: ApiVersion        # 2.1.0
  requestSchema: JsonSchema
  responseSchema: JsonSchema
  changes: array<string>     # ["Added 'metadata' field", ...]
  backwardCompatible: bool

struct ApiGatewayConfig
  currentVersion: ApiVersion  # 2.1.0
  supportedVersions: array<ApiVersion>  # [1.0.0, 2.0.0, 2.1.0]
  deprecatedVersions: array<ApiVersion> # []
  defaultVersion: ApiVersion  # 2.1.0
  versionHeader: string      # "X-API-Version"
  endpoints: map<string, array<ApiEndpointVersion>>
```

### 3. 버전 관리 라이프사이클

```
// 버전 지원 상태
Active:       모든 기능 지원
Deprecated:   지원하지만, 마이그레이션 권장 (3개월 이상)
Sunset:       완전 중단 (더 이상 요청 거부)

Timeline Example (v1.0.0):
2024-01-01: Release (releaseDate)
2024-10-01: Deprecation announced (deprecationDate)
2025-01-01: Sunset, 404 responses (sunsettingDate)
```

### 4. Backward Compatibility 검증

```
fn ensureBackwardCompatibility(
  oldEndpoint: ApiEndpointVersion,
  newEndpoint: ApiEndpointVersion
) -> bool
  // 1. Same path and method
  if oldEndpoint["path"] != newEndpoint["path"] ||
     oldEndpoint["method"] != newEndpoint["method"]
    return false

  // 2. New version > old version
  if compareVersions(newEndpoint["version"], oldEndpoint["version"]) <= 0
    return false

  // 3. Backward compatible flag (must be true)
  return newEndpoint["backwardCompatible"]
```

**호환성 규칙**:

- ❌ 필수 필드 추가
- ❌ 상태 코드 제거

```

fn registerEndpointVersion(
  config: ApiGatewayConfig,
  path: string,
  method: string,
  version: ApiVersion,
  backwardCompatible: bool
) -> ApiGatewayConfig
  let key = method + " " + path  // "POST /api/vector/insert"
  let endpoint = {
    "path": path,
    "method": method,
    "version": version,
    "requestSchema": createJsonSchema(key, versionToString(version)),
    "responseSchema": createJsonSchema(key + "_response", versionToString(version)),
    "changes": [],
    "backwardCompatible": backwardCompatible
  }
  config["endpoints"][key].append(endpoint)
  return config

fn getEndpointForVersion(
  config: ApiGatewayConfig,

) -> Result<ApiEndpointVersion, string>
  // Find closest compatible version

```

```
fn deleteUserData(
```

## 🔐 보안 레이어 구현

### Week 1: 기본 보안 (5개 모듈, 1,812줄)

#### TLS 1.2/1.3 암호화
```
tls_handler.fl (337줄)
├─ TLS Handshake (ClientHello, ServerHello, ...)
├─ Cipher Suites: TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
├─ ECDHE Key Exchange (Elliptic Curve)
└─ AES-256-GCM Encryption/Decryption
```

**보안 특성**:
- 256-bit 대칭키 (AES-256)
- 타원곡선 키 교환 (ECDHE, Perfect Forward Secrecy)
- Authentication tag (AEAD, GCM mode)
- Certificate chain verification

#### JWT 토큰 인증
```
jwt_auth.fl (413줄)
├─ Token Generation (HS256/RS256 signing)
├─ Token Validation (signature + claim verification)
├─ Token Refresh (1-hour + 7-day)
└─ User Identity Extraction
```

**토큰 페이로드**:
```json
{
  "sub": "user-12345",
  "roles": ["user", "admin"],
  "permissions": ["vec_read", "vec_write"],
  "iat": 1740998400,
  "exp": 1741002000
}
```

#### Token Bucket Rate Limiting
```
rate_limiter.fl (346줄)
├─ Token bucket: capacity = 100 tokens
├─ Refill rate: 10 tokens/minute
├─ Sliding window: 5분 (300초)
└─ DDoS detection: 100+ failures/min → block
```

**정책**:
- 일반 사용자: 100 req/min
- VIP 사용자: 1000 req/min
- API endpoint: 10,000 req/hour

#### RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)
```
rbac.fl (398줄)
├─ 4 Roles: guest(0), user(1), admin(2), super-admin(3)
├─ 9 Permissions: vec_read, vec_write, vec_delete, ...
├─ ACL (Access Control List): per-resource grants
└─ User management: active, suspended, deleted
```

**권한 매트릭스**:
```
Guest:       vec_read, vec_search
User:        + vec_write, cls_status
Admin:       + vec_delete, cls_manage, sys_user_manage
Super-Admin: + cls_admin, sys_admin, sys_audit
```

#### 5단계 보안 파이프라인
```
security_middleware.fl (318줄)
1. IP Filtering (whitelist/blacklist)
2. Rate Limiting (token bucket)
3. TLS Verification (handshake)
4. JWT Authentication (token validation)
5. RBAC Authorization (permission check)
```

**결과**: 모든 요청이 5개 계층을 통과해야 처리됨

### Week 2: 고급 Rate Limiting (350줄)

#### 사용자별 정책
- VIP: 10,000 req/hour
- 표준: 1,000 req/hour
- 무료: 100 req/hour

#### API 별 정책
- 검색 (비용 높음): 10,000 req/hour
- 삽입: 5,000 req/hour
- 상태: 무제한

#### IP 신뢰도 스코어 (0-100)
```
계산: baseScore(50) + successBonus(0-20) - failurePenalty(0-40) - recentPenalty(10)

80-100: High Trust (제한 없음)
50-79:  Medium Trust (표준 제한)
20-49:  Low Trust (강화 제한)
<20:    Blocked (차단)
```

#### 시간대 제한
```
"금요일 17:00 ~ 월요일 09:00" 배치 작업 제한
주말 제한: 최대 50 req/min
```

#### 지역 제한
```
allowedCountries: ["KR", "US", "JP"]
geoIpDb: { "1.2.3.4" → "KR" }
```

#### 동적 버스트 조정
```
systemLoad > 80% → reductionFactor = 0.5 (50% 감소)
systemLoad > 60% → reductionFactor = 0.75 (75% 감소)
```

### Week 3: 입력 검증 & 에러 처리 (400줄)

#### JSON Schema 검증
```
struct ValidationRule
  fieldName: string
  fieldType: "string" | "number" | "array" | "object"
  required: bool
  minLength / maxLength: number
  pattern: "email" | "uuid" | "url"
  allowedValues: array<string>  # Whitelist
```

#### 3가지 공격 방어

**SQL Injection**:
```
Input:  "admin'; DROP TABLE users; --"
Escape: "admin''; DROP TABLE users; --"
Query:  "SELECT * WHERE name = ?"
Param:  ["admin''; DROP TABLE users; --"]
→ 일반 문자열로 처리, 쿼리 구조 불변
```

**XSS (Cross-Site Scripting)**:
```
Input:  "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
Escape: "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
→ HTML 렌더링 시 텍스트로 표시됨
```

**Type Mismatch**:
```
Expected: number (0-1000)
Received: "huge_value"
→ Error: TYPE_MISMATCH, 요청 거부
```

#### 안전한 에러 응답 (내부 정보 노출 금지)

**❌ 위험한 응답**:
```json
{
  "error": "Database connection failed at line 247 in db.py",
  "stack": "... full stack trace ..."
}
```

**✅ 안전한 응답**:
```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "statusCode": 400,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Request validation failed"
  },
  "fieldErrors": {
    "email": "INVALID_VALUE",
    "age": "MIN_VALUE"
  }
}
```

#### 요청 로깅 (민감정보 제거)

**로그 항목**:
```
REQUEST[req-123] POST /api/insert 200 5ms user=u****d ip=1****0
```

**제거된 정보**:
- userId: "user-12345" → "u****5"
- ipAddress: "192.168.1.100" → "1****0"

### Week 4: API 버전 관리 & GDPR (400줄)

#### Semantic Versioning
```
Version: major.minor.patch
Example: 2.1.0

Rules:
- Major: Breaking changes (v1 → v2)
- Minor: New features, backward compatible (v2.0 → v2.1)
- Patch: Bug fixes (v2.1.0 → v2.1.1)
```

#### Backward Compatibility 보장

**✅ 호환성 유지**:
- 필드 추가 (신규, 선택)
- 상태 코드 추가
- 새로운 endpoint 추가

**❌ 호환성 파괴**:
- 필드 제거
- 필드 타입 변경
- 필수 필드 추가

#### 버전 라이프사이클

```
Timeline: v1.0.0

2024-01-01: Release (releaseDate)
   → supportedVersions = [1.0.0]

2024-10-01: Deprecation announced (deprecationDate)
   → "v1.0.0 마이그레이션 권장" 메시지

2025-01-01: Sunset (sunsettingDate)
   → v1.0.0 요청 → 404 "Endpoint Deprecated"
```

#### GDPR 규제 준수

**Right to Access** (접근권):
```
GET /api/users/me/export
→ JSON으로 모든 개인정보 반환
→ 48시간 내 제공 (GDPR 요구)
```

**Right to be Forgotten** (삭제권):
```
DELETE /api/users/me
→ 모든 PII 삭제
→ 감사 로그만 보관 (법적 요구)
```

**Data Portability** (이동권):
```
exportUserData() → JSON 포맷
→ 다른 서비스로 쉽게 이전 가능
```

**Audit Trail** (감시 추적):
```
ComplianceLogEntry:
  timestamp: 1740998400
  eventType: "ACCESS" | "MODIFICATION" | "DELETION" | "EXPORT"
  userId: "user-123"
  action: "read" | "write" | "delete"
  oldValue: "..."
  newValue: "..."
  approved: true
  approver: "admin-001"
```

**로그 보관**:
```
GDPR: ≥30일 (일반), 365일 (권장)
HIPAA: 6년 (의료 기록)
SOC 2: 1년
```

```

├─ Cipher Suites: TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
```

**보안 특성**:
- 256-bit 대칭키 (AES-256)

#### JWT 토큰 인증
```
jwt_auth.fl (413줄)
├─ Token Generation (HS256/RS256 signing)
├─ Token Validation (signature + claim verification)
├─ Token Refresh (1-hour + 7-day)
└─ User Identity Extraction
```

**토큰 페이로드**:
```json
{
  "sub": "user-12345",
  "roles": ["user", "admin"],
  "permissions": ["vec_read", "vec_write"],
  "iat": 1740998400,
  "exp": 1741002000
}
```

#### Token Bucket Rate Limiting
```
rate_limiter.fl (346줄)
├─ Token bucket: capacity = 100 tokens
├─ Refill rate: 10 tokens/minute
├─ Sliding window: 5분 (300초)
└─ DDoS detection: 100+ failures/min → block
```

**정책**:
- 일반 사용자: 100 req/min
- VIP 사용자: 1000 req/min
- API endpoint: 10,000 req/hour

#### RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)
```
rbac.fl (398줄)
├─ 4 Roles: guest(0), user(1), admin(2), super-admin(3)
├─ 9 Permissions: vec_read, vec_write, vec_delete, ...
├─ ACL (Access Control List): per-resource grants
└─ User management: active, suspended, deleted
```

**권한 매트릭스**:
```
Guest:       vec_read, vec_search
User:        + vec_write, cls_status
Admin:       + vec_delete, cls_manage, sys_user_manage
Super-Admin: + cls_admin, sys_admin, sys_audit
```

#### 5단계 보안 파이프라인
```
security_middleware.fl (318줄)
1. IP Filtering (whitelist/blacklist)
2. Rate Limiting (token bucket)
3. TLS Verification (handshake)
4. JWT Authentication (token validation)
5. RBAC Authorization (permission check)
```

**결과**: 모든 요청이 5개 계층을 통과해야 처리됨

- VIP: 10,000 req/hour
- 표준: 1,000 req/hour
- 무료: 100 req/hour

- 삽입: 5,000 req/hour
- 상태: 무제한

#### IP 신뢰도 스코어 (0-100)
```
계산: baseScore(50) + successBonus(0-20) - failurePenalty(0-40) - recentPenalty(10)

80-100: High Trust (제한 없음)
50-79:  Medium Trust (표준 제한)
20-49:  Low Trust (강화 제한)
<20:    Blocked (차단)
```

#### 시간대 제한
```
"금요일 17:00 ~ 월요일 09:00" 배치 작업 제한
주말 제한: 최대 50 req/min
```

```
allowedCountries: ["KR", "US", "JP"]
geoIpDb: { "1.2.3.4" → "KR" }
```

#### 동적 버스트 조정
```
systemLoad > 80% → reductionFactor = 0.5 (50% 감소)
systemLoad > 60% → reductionFactor = 0.75 (75% 감소)
```

### Week 3: 입력 검증 & 에러 처리 (400줄)

```
struct ValidationRule
  fieldName: string
  fieldType: "string" | "number" | "array" | "object"
  required: bool
  minLength / maxLength: number
  pattern: "email" | "uuid" | "url"
  allowedValues: array<string>  # Whitelist
```

#### 3가지 공격 방어

**SQL Injection**:
```
Input:  "admin'; DROP TABLE users; --"
Escape: "admin''; DROP TABLE users; --"
Query:  "SELECT * WHERE name = ?"
Param:  ["admin''; DROP TABLE users; --"]
→ 일반 문자열로 처리, 쿼리 구조 불변
```

**XSS (Cross-Site Scripting)**:
```
Input:  "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
Escape: "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
→ HTML 렌더링 시 텍스트로 표시됨
```

**Type Mismatch**:
```
Expected: number (0-1000)
Received: "huge_value"
→ Error: TYPE_MISMATCH, 요청 거부
```

```json
}
```

**✅ 안전한 응답**:

```json
  "statusCode": 400,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Request validation failed"
  },
  "fieldErrors": {
    "email": "INVALID_VALUE",
    "age": "MIN_VALUE"
  }
}
```

**로그 항목**:
```
REQUEST[req-123] POST /api/insert 200 5ms user=u****d ip=1****0
```

**제거된 정보**:
- userId: "user-12345" → "u****5"
- ipAddress: "192.168.1.100" → "1****0"


**캐싱 전략**:

```
1. Cache-Aside (Lazy Loading)
   if cache.has(key)
     return cache.get(key)
   else
     value = fetchFromDB()
     cache.set(key, value, ttl)
     return value

2. Tag-based Invalidation
   cache.set("vector:123", data, tags=["vector", "user:456"])
   // 사용자 데이터 변경:
   cache.invalidateByTag("user:456")  // 해당 벡터도 무효화됨

3. Pattern Invalidation
   cache.invalidateByPattern("user:456:*")  // 사용자의 모든 캐시 제거

4. Warm-up (사전 로딩)
   cache.warmUpCache(["popular:1", "popular:2", ...])
```

- 자주 조회되는 벡터 (성능 10배 향상)

```
fn cacheAside(cache, key, fetchFn, ttl, tenantId) -> Result<string, string>  # Lazy load
fn warmUpCache(cache, keys: array<string>, tenantId) -> Result<number, string>
fn pruneExpiredEntries(cache) -> Result<number, string>
```

**캐싱 전략**:

```
1. Cache-Aside (Lazy Loading)
   if cache.has(key)
     return cache.get(key)
   else
     value = fetchFromDB()
     cache.set(key, value, ttl)
     return value

2. Tag-based Invalidation
   cache.set("vector:123", data, tags=["vector", "user:456"])
   // 사용자 데이터 변경:
   cache.invalidateByTag("user:456")  // 해당 벡터도 무효화됨

3. Pattern Invalidation
   cache.invalidateByPattern("user:456:*")  // 사용자의 모든 캐시 제거

4. Warm-up (사전 로딩)
   cache.warmUpCache(["popular:1", "popular:2", ...])
```

**사용 사례**:
- 자주 조회되는 벡터 (성능 10배 향상)
- 클러스터 메타데이터 (상태 갱신)

**Trace 예시**:

```
Request: POST /api/vector/insert

Trace ID: trace-12345
├─ Span 1: API Handler (10ms)
│  ├─ [0-2ms] TLS Decrypt
│  ├─ [2-3ms] JWT Validate
│  └─ [3-10ms] Authorization
│
├─ Span 2: Vector Processing (30ms)
│  ├─ [0-5ms] Vector Normalization
│  └─ [5-30ms] LSH Index Lookup
│
├─ Span 3: Raft Consensus (50ms)
│  ├─ [0-10ms] Log Append
│  ├─ [10-40ms] Heartbeat + Replicate
│  └─ [40-50ms] Leader Commit
│
├─ Span 4: Cache Write (5ms)
│  └─ [0-5ms] Redis SET
│
└─ Span 5: Response (5ms)
   └─ [0-5ms] JSON Serialize

Total: ~100ms
Critical Path: Raft (50ms) > Vector (30ms) > API (10ms) > Cache (5ms) > Response (5ms)
→ Raft이 병목, 최적화 여지 있음
```

```

  ↓

  ├─ Security (span: tls, jwt, rbac)
  ├─ Coordinator (span: route-request)
  │  └─ Raft Cluster (span: raft-consensus)
  │     ├─ Node 1 (span: replicate)
  │     ├─ Node 2 (span: replicate)
  │     └─ Node 3 (span: replicate)
  ├─ Cache (span: cache-set)
  └─ Response (span: serialize)

모든 Span이 traceId로 연결 → 전체 경로 가시화
```

**목적**: 이상 감지 + 알림 생성

#### 파일: `src/alerts/anomaly_detection.fl`

```
struct AlertRule
  ruleId: string
  name: string                 # "High Latency Alert"
  metric: string               # "request_latency_p99"
  condition: string            # "> 1000"  (threshold or expression)
  duration: number             # Sustained for N seconds
  severity: string             # "CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"
  notificationChannels: array<string>  # ["slack", "email", "pagerduty"]

struct Anomaly
  anomalyId: string
  ruleId: string
  timestamp: number
  metric: string
  currentValue: number
  threshold: number
  deviation: number            # Standard deviations from mean
  explanation: string
  suggestedAction: string

struct AnomalyDetectionConfig
  statisticalMethod: string    # "zscore", "iqr", "isolation_forest"
  baselineWindow: number       # 24 hours (86400 seconds)
  detectionWindow: number      # 5 minutes
  sensitivity: number          # 0.5-2.0 (lower = more sensitive)

struct AnomalyDetector
  config: AnomalyDetectionConfig
  rules: array<AlertRule>
  anomalies: array<Anomaly>
  baselineMetrics: map<string, array<number>>
  notificationHistory: array<map<string, any>>

fn newAnomalyDetector(config: AnomalyDetectionConfig) -> AnomalyDetector
fn addAlertRule(detector, rule: AlertRule) -> Result<bool, string>
fn detectAnomalies(detector, currentMetrics: map<string, number>) -> array<Anomaly>
fn calculateZScore(detector, metric: string, value: number) -> number
fn getBaseline(detector, metric: string) -> map<string, number>  # mean, stddev, min, max
fn sendNotification(detector, anomaly: Anomaly) -> Result<bool, string>
fn acknowledgeAnomaly(detector, anomalyId: string) -> Result<bool, string>
fn getAlertHistory(detector, timeRange) -> array<Anomaly>
fn calculateFalsePositiveRate(detector) -> number
fn updateBaseline(detector, metric: string) -> Result<bool, string>
```

**이상 탐지 방법**:

```
1. Z-Score (Statistical)
   zscore = (value - mean) / stddev

   Example:
   - Mean latency: 50ms
   - StdDev: 10ms
   - Current: 100ms
   - Z-score: (100-50)/10 = 5.0

   Rule: Z-score > 3.0 (99.7% threshold)
   → Alert! Anomaly detected

2. IQR (Interquartile Range)
   Lower = Q1 - 1.5 × IQR
   Upper = Q3 + 1.5 × IQR

   If value < Lower or > Upper → Anomaly

3. Isolation Forest
   Detects outliers by isolation path length
   More robust to non-Gaussian distributions
```

**알림 규칙 예**:

```
Rule 1: High Latency
  metric: request_latency_p99
  condition: > 1000ms
  duration: 60 seconds (sustained)
  severity: HIGH
  channels: [slack, pagerduty]
  Action: "Check Raft replication status"

Rule 2: High Error Rate
  metric: error_rate
  condition: > 5%
  duration: 30 seconds
  severity: CRITICAL
  channels: [slack, email, pagerduty]
  Action: "Check application logs"

Rule 3: Cache Miss Spike
  metric: cache_hit_ratio
  condition: < 60% AND zscore > 2.0
  duration: 120 seconds
  severity: MEDIUM
  channels: [slack]
  Action: "Check cache eviction"
```

```
struct Metric

  value: number
  unit: string                 # "ms", "MB", "count", "%"
  timestamp: number
  labels: map<string, string>  # {"method": "POST", "endpoint": "/insert"}

struct MetricTimeSeries

struct PerformanceMetrics
  // API Performance
  requestLatency: MetricTimeSeries      # P50, P95, P99
  throughput: MetricTimeSeries          # req/sec
  errorRate: MetricTimeSeries           # %

  // System Performance
  cpuUsage: MetricTimeSeries            # %
  memoryUsage: MetricTimeSeries         # MB
```

**메트릭 정의**:

```
Request Latency:
  P50: 50th percentile (중간값)
  P95: 95th percentile (거의 모든 요청)
  P99: 99th percentile (최악의 경우)

Example: P50=5ms, P95=20ms, P99=100ms
→ 50% 요청은 5ms 이내, 99%는 100ms 이내

Throughput: 초당 처리 요청 수
  Example: 10,000 req/sec

Error Rate: 실패한 요청 비율
  Example: 0.5% (5000 중 25개 실패)
```

**목적**: 요청 전체 경로 추적 (End-to-end visibility)

```
struct TraceContext
  traceId: string              # Unique ID for entire request
  spanId: string               # Unique ID for this operation
  parentSpanId: string         # Parent operation ID
  samplingRate: number         # 0.0 to 1.0

struct Span
  spanId: string
  traceId: string
  parentSpanId: string
  operationName: string        # "http.request", "db.query", "cache.get"
  serviceName: string          # "api-server", "vector-db", "cache"
  startTime: number
  endTime: number
  duration: number             # milliseconds
  tags: map<string, string>    # {"http.method": "POST", "http.path": "/api/insert"}
  logs: array<LogEntry>        # Debug logs within span
  status: string               # "OK", "ERROR", "TIMEOUT"

struct LogEntry
  timestamp: number
  message: string
  level: string                # "DEBUG", "INFO", "WARN", "ERROR"

struct Trace
  traceId: string
  userId: string
  startTime: number
  endTime: number
  duration: number
  spans: array<Span>
  tags: map<string, string>    # Request-level tags

struct DistributedTracingConfig
  jaegerUrl: string            # "http://localhost:6831"
  serviceName: string          # "freelang-backend"
  samplingRate: number         # 0.1 (10% of requests)
  maxSpansPerTrace: number     # 1000

struct TracingCollector
  config: DistributedTracingConfig
  traces: array<Trace>
  spans: array<Span>

fn newTracingCollector(config: DistributedTracingConfig) -> TracingCollector
fn startSpan(collector, traceContext, operationName, serviceName) -> Span
fn endSpan(collector, span, status) -> Result<bool, string>
fn setSpanTag(span, key, value) -> Span
fn logSpanEvent(span, message, level) -> Span
fn getTrace(collector, traceId) -> Result<Trace, string>
fn getTraceTree(collector, traceId) -> string  # ASCII tree
fn analyzeTraceCriticalPath(collector, traceId) -> array<Span>  # Slowest path
fn getLatencyByService(collector, traceId) -> map<string, number>
fn exportTraceToJaeger(collector, trace) -> Result<string, string>
```

**Trace 예시**:

```
Request: POST /api/vector/insert

Trace ID: trace-12345
├─ Span 1: API Handler (10ms)
│  ├─ [0-2ms] TLS Decrypt
│  ├─ [2-3ms] JWT Validate
│  └─ [3-10ms] Authorization
│
├─ Span 2: Vector Processing (30ms)
│  ├─ [0-5ms] Vector Normalization
│  └─ [5-30ms] LSH Index Lookup
│
├─ Span 3: Raft Consensus (50ms)
│  ├─ [0-10ms] Log Append
│  ├─ [10-40ms] Heartbeat + Replicate
│  └─ [40-50ms] Leader Commit
│
├─ Span 4: Cache Write (5ms)
│  └─ [0-5ms] Redis SET
│
└─ Span 5: Response (5ms)
   └─ [0-5ms] JSON Serialize

Total: ~100ms
Critical Path: Raft (50ms) > Vector (30ms) > API (10ms) > Cache (5ms) > Response (5ms)
→ Raft이 병목, 최적화 여지 있음
```

**서비스 간 추적**:

```
Client
  ↓
API Server (span: api-handler)
  ├─ Security (span: tls, jwt, rbac)
  ├─ Coordinator (span: route-request)
  │  └─ Raft Cluster (span: raft-consensus)
  │     ├─ Node 1 (span: replicate)
  │     ├─ Node 2 (span: replicate)
  │     └─ Node 3 (span: replicate)
  ├─ Cache (span: cache-set)
  └─ Response (span: serialize)

모든 Span이 traceId로 연결 → 전체 경로 가시화
```

### 모듈 3: Real-time Alerts (500줄)

**목적**: 이상 감지 + 알림 생성

#### 파일: `src/alerts/anomaly_detection.fl`

```
struct AlertRule
  ruleId: string
  name: string                 # "High Latency Alert"
  metric: string               # "request_latency_p99"
  condition: string            # "> 1000"  (threshold or expression)
  duration: number             # Sustained for N seconds
  severity: string             # "CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"
  notificationChannels: array<string>  # ["slack", "email", "pagerduty"]

struct Anomaly
  anomalyId: string
  ruleId: string
  timestamp: number
  metric: string
  currentValue: number
  threshold: number
  deviation: number            # Standard deviations from mean
  explanation: string
  suggestedAction: string

struct AnomalyDetectionConfig
  statisticalMethod: string    # "zscore", "iqr", "isolation_forest"
  baselineWindow: number       # 24 hours (86400 seconds)
  detectionWindow: number      # 5 minutes
  sensitivity: number          # 0.5-2.0 (lower = more sensitive)

struct AnomalyDetector
  config: AnomalyDetectionConfig
  rules: array<AlertRule>
  anomalies: array<Anomaly>
  baselineMetrics: map<string, array<number>>
  notificationHistory: array<map<string, any>>

fn newAnomalyDetector(config: AnomalyDetectionConfig) -> AnomalyDetector
fn addAlertRule(detector, rule: AlertRule) -> Result<bool, string>
fn detectAnomalies(detector, currentMetrics: map<string, number>) -> array<Anomaly>
fn calculateZScore(detector, metric: string, value: number) -> number
fn getBaseline(detector, metric: string) -> map<string, number>  # mean, stddev, min, max
fn sendNotification(detector, anomaly: Anomaly) -> Result<bool, string>
fn acknowledgeAnomaly(detector, anomalyId: string) -> Result<bool, string>
fn getAlertHistory(detector, timeRange) -> array<Anomaly>
fn calculateFalsePositiveRate(detector) -> number
fn updateBaseline(detector, metric: string) -> Result<bool, string>
```

**이상 탐지 방법**:

```
1. Z-Score (Statistical)
   zscore = (value - mean) / stddev

   Example:
   - Mean latency: 50ms
   - StdDev: 10ms
   - Current: 100ms
   - Z-score: (100-50)/10 = 5.0

   Rule: Z-score > 3.0 (99.7% threshold)
   → Alert! Anomaly detected

2. IQR (Interquartile Range)
   Lower = Q1 - 1.5 × IQR
   Upper = Q3 + 1.5 × IQR

   If value < Lower or > Upper → Anomaly

3. Isolation Forest
   Detects outliers by isolation path length
   More robust to non-Gaussian distributions
```

**알림 규칙 예**:

```
Rule 1: High Latency
  metric: request_latency_p99
  condition: > 1000ms
  duration: 60 seconds (sustained)
  severity: HIGH
  channels: [slack, pagerduty]
  Action: "Check Raft replication status"

Rule 2: High Error Rate
  metric: error_rate
  condition: > 5%
  duration: 30 seconds
  severity: CRITICAL
  channels: [slack, email, pagerduty]
  Action: "Check application logs"

Rule 3: Cache Miss Spike
  metric: cache_hit_ratio
  condition: < 60% AND zscore > 2.0
  duration: 120 seconds
  severity: MEDIUM
  channels: [slack]
  Action: "Check cache eviction"
```

// ============================================================================
// Real-time Streaming: Persistent WebSocket + Topic-based Pub/Sub - Phase 6
// Subscription Management, Message Replay, Backpressure (500줄)
// ============================================================================

// Stream Subscription
struct StreamSubscription
  subscriptionId: string
  clientId: string
  topic: string
  filters: map<string, any>
  createdAt: number
  isActive: bool
  messageCount: number

// Topic Message
struct TopicMessage
  messageId: string
  topic: string
  timestamp: number
  data: string
  sender: string
  priority: number

// Streaming Configuration
struct StreamingConfig
  maxSubscriptionsPerClient: number
  queueSize: number
  heartbeatInterval: number
  maxBacklogMessages: number
  maxMessageSize: number

// Streaming Server
struct StreamingServer
  subscriptions: array<StreamSubscription>
  topicQueues: map<string, array<TopicMessage>>
  clientSubscriptions: map<string, array<string>>
  config: StreamingConfig
  stats: map<string, any>

// Create new streaming server
fn newStreamingServer(config: StreamingConfig) -> StreamingServer
  {
    "subscriptions": [],
    "topicQueues": {},
    "clientSubscriptions": {},
    "config": config,
    "stats": {
      "totalMessages": 0,
      "totalSubscriptions": 0,
      "activeConnections": 0
    }
  }

// Subscribe to topic
fn subscribe(
  server: StreamingServer,
  clientId: string,
  topic: string,
  filters: map<string, any>
) -> Result<string, string>
  // Check subscription limit
  let clientSubs = server["clientSubscriptions"][clientId] || []
  if clientSubs.length() >= server["config"]["maxSubscriptionsPerClient"]
    return Err("Max subscriptions exceeded")

  // Create subscription
  let subscriptionId = generateSubscriptionId(clientId + topic)
  let subscription = {
    "subscriptionId": subscriptionId,
    "clientId": clientId,
    "topic": topic,
    "filters": filters,
    "createdAt": getCurrentTime(),
    "isActive": true,
    "messageCount": 0
  }

  server["subscriptions"].append(subscription)
  clientSubs.append(subscriptionId)
  server["clientSubscriptions"][clientId] = clientSubs

  // Initialize topic queue if needed
  if server["topicQueues"][topic] == nil
    server["topicQueues"][topic] = []

  Ok(subscriptionId)

// Unsubscribe from topic
fn unsubscribe(
  server: StreamingServer,
  subscriptionId: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let newSubs = []
  let found = false

  for sub in server["subscriptions"]
    if sub["subscriptionId"] != subscriptionId
      newSubs.append(sub)
    else
      found = true

  if !found
    return Err("Subscription not found")

  server["subscriptions"] = newSubs
  Ok(true)

// Publish message to topic
fn publish(
  server: StreamingServer,
  topic: string,
  message: string,
  sender: string
) -> Result<number, string>
  // Check message size
  if message.length() > server["config"]["maxMessageSize"]
    return Err("Message too large")

  // Create message
  let msg = {
    "messageId": generateMessageId(),
    "topic": topic,
    "timestamp": getCurrentTime(),
    "data": message,
    "sender": sender,
    "priority": 0

// ============================================================================
// Multi-tenant Support: Tenant Isolation & Resource Quotas - Phase 6 Track A
// Billing Integration, Feature Flags (500줄)
// ============================================================================

// Tenant Definition
struct Tenant
  tenantId: string
  name: string
  owner: string
  createdAt: number
  status: string
  tierLevel: number

// Tenant Quota
struct TenantQuota
  tenantId: string
  maxVectors: number
  maxRequests: number
  maxStorageGB: number
  maxConcurrentConnections: number
  featureFlags: array<string>

// Tenant Resource
struct TenantResource
  tenantId: string
  resourceId: string
  ownerId: string
  createdAt: number
  resourceType: string

// Tenant Billing
struct TenantBilling
  tenantId: string
  billingPeriod: string
  vectorsCreated: number
  requestsProcessed: number
  storageUsedGB: number
  cost: number
  status: string

// Tenant Manager
struct TenantManager
  tenants: map<string, Tenant>
  quotas: map<string, TenantQuota>
  resources: array<TenantResource>
  billing: array<TenantBilling>
  pricingTiers: map<string, map<string, any>>

// Create tenant manager
fn newTenantManager() -> TenantManager
  {
    "tenants": {},
    "quotas": {},
    "resources": [],
    "billing": [],
    "pricingTiers": {
      "free": {
        "baseCost": 0,
        "maxVectors": 1000,
        "maxRequests": 100,
        "maxStorageGB": 1,
        "maxConcurrentConnections": 5,
        "features": ["basic_search"]
      },
      "pro": {
        "baseCost": 99,
        "maxVectors": 100000,
        "maxRequests": 10000,
        "maxStorageGB": 100,
        "maxConcurrentConnections": 50,
        "features": ["basic_search", "advanced_search", "api_access", "webhooks"]
      },
      "enterprise": {
        "baseCost": 0,
        "maxVectors": 999999999,
        "maxRequests": 999999999,
        "maxStorageGB": 999999,
        "maxConcurrentConnections": 999,
        "features": ["all"]
      }
    }
  }

// Create tenant
fn createTenant(
  manager: TenantManager,
  name: string,
  owner: string,
  tierLevel: number
) -> Result<Tenant, string>
  let tenantId = generateTenantId(name)

  let tenant = {
    "tenantId": tenantId,
    "name": name,
    "owner": owner,
    "createdAt": getCurrentTime(),
    "status": "ACTIVE",
    "tierLevel": tierLevel
  }

  manager["tenants"][tenantId] = tenant

  // Set quota based on tier
  let tierName = ""
  match tierLevel
    1 -> tierName = "free"
    2 -> tierName = "pro"
    3 -> tierName = "enterprise"
    _ -> tierName = "free"

  let tierConfig = manager["pricingTiers"][tierName] || {}
  let quota = {
    "tenantId": tenantId,
    "maxVectors": tierConfig["maxVectors"] || 1000,
    "maxRequests": tierConfig["maxRequests"] || 100,
    "maxStorageGB": tierConfig["maxStorageGB"] || 1,
    "maxConcurrentConnections": tierConfig["maxConcurrentConnections"] || 5,
    "featureFlags": tierConfig["features"] || []
  }

  manager["quotas"][tenantId] = quota

  Ok(tenant)

// Get tenant
fn getTenant(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string
) -> Result<Tenant, string>
  let tenant = manager["tenants"][tenantId]
  if tenant == nil
    Err("Tenant not found")
  else
    Ok(tenant)

// Update tenant quota
fn updateTenantQuota(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string,
  quota: TenantQuota
) -> Result<TenantQuota, string>
  if manager["tenants"][tenantId] == nil
    return Err("Tenant not found")

  manager["quotas"][tenantId] = quota
  Ok(quota)

// Allocate resource to tenant
fn allocateResource(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string,
  resourceId: string,
  ownerId: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  if manager["tenants"][tenantId] == nil
    return Err("Tenant not found")

  let resource = {
    "tenantId": tenantId,
    "resourceId": resourceId,
    "ownerId": ownerId,
    "createdAt": getCurrentTime(),
    "resourceType": "vector"
  }

  manager["resources"].append(resource)
  Ok(true)

// Check quota
fn checkQuota(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string,
  resourceType: string,
  count: number
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let quota = manager["quotas"][tenantId]
  if quota == nil
    return Err("Tenant not found")

  match resourceType
    "vectors" ->
      let used = 0
      for resource in manager["resources"]
        if resource["tenantId"] == tenantId && resource["resourceType"] == "vector"
          used = used + 1
      if used + count > quota["maxVectors"]
        Err("Vector quota exceeded")
      else
        Ok(true)
    "requests" ->
      Ok(true)
    _ -> Ok(true)

// Get tenant resources
fn getTenantResources(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string
) -> array<TenantResource>
  let result = []
  for resource in manager["resources"]
    if resource["tenantId"] == tenantId
      result.append(resource)
  result

// Delete resource
fn deleteResource(
  manager: TenantManager,
  resourceId: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let newResources = []
  let found = false

  for resource in manager["resources"]
    if resource["resourceId"] != resourceId
      newResources.append(resource)
    else
      found = true

  if !found
    return Err("Resource not found")

  manager["resources"] = newResources
  Ok(true)

// Generate billing record
fn generateBillingRecord(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string,
  billingPeriod: string,
  vectorsCreated: number,
  requestsProcessed: number,
  storageUsedGB: number
) -> Result<TenantBilling, string>
  let tenant = manager["tenants"][tenantId]
  if tenant == nil
    return Err("Tenant not found")

  // Get tier config
  let tierName = ""
  match tenant["tierLevel"]
    1 -> tierName = "free"
    2 -> tierName = "pro"
    3 -> tierName = "enterprise"
    _ -> tierName = "free"

  let tierConfig = manager["pricingTiers"][tierName] || {}
  let baseCost = tierConfig["baseCost"] || 0

  // Calculate costs
  let vectorCost = 0
  let requestCost = 0
  let storageCost = 0

  // Simple pricing model
  match tierName
    "free" ->
      vectorCost = if vectorsCreated > 1000 then (vectorsCreated - 1000) * 0.001 else 0
      requestCost = if requestsProcessed > 100 then (requestsProcessed - 100) * 0.0001 else 0
      storageCost = if storageUsedGB > 1 then (storageUsedGB - 1) * 0.5 else 0
    "pro" ->
      vectorCost = if vectorsCreated > 100000 then (vectorsCreated - 100000) * 0.0001 else 0
      requestCost = if requestsProcessed > 10000 then (requestsProcessed - 10000) * 0.00001 else 0
      storageCost = if storageUsedGB > 100 then (storageUsedGB - 100) * 0.1 else 0
    _ ->
      vectorCost = 0
      requestCost = 0
      storageCost = 0

  let totalCost = baseCost + vectorCost + requestCost + storageCost

  let billing = {
    "tenantId": tenantId,
    "billingPeriod": billingPeriod,
    "vectorsCreated": vectorsCreated,
    "requestsProcessed": requestsProcessed,
    "storageUsedGB": storageUsedGB,
    "cost": totalCost,
    "status": "PENDING"
  }

  manager["billing"].append(billing)
  Ok(billing)

// Suspend tenant
fn suspendTenant(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string,
  reason: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let tenant = manager["tenants"][tenantId]
  if tenant == nil
    return Err("Tenant not found")

  tenant["status"] = "SUSPENDED"
  manager["tenants"][tenantId] = tenant
  Ok(true)

// Activate tenant
fn activateTenant(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let tenant = manager["tenants"][tenantId]
  if tenant == nil
    return Err("Tenant not found")

  tenant["status"] = "ACTIVE"
  manager["tenants"][tenantId] = tenant
  Ok(true)

// Check feature flag
fn hasFeature(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string,
  feature: string
) -> bool
  let quota = manager["quotas"][tenantId]
  if quota == nil
    return false

  for flag in quota["featureFlags"]
    if flag == feature || flag == "all"
      return true

  false

// List all tenants
fn listTenants(manager: TenantManager) -> array<Tenant>
  let result = []
  for tenantId in manager["tenants"].keys()
    result.append(manager["tenants"][tenantId])
  result

// Get tenant statistics
fn getTenantStats(
  manager: TenantManager,
  tenantId: string
) -> map<string, any>
  let resources = getTenantResources(manager, tenantId)
  let quota = manager["quotas"][tenantId] || {}

  {
    "tenantId": tenantId,
    "resourceCount": resources.length(),
    "maxVectors": quota["maxVectors"] || 0,
    "usedVectors": resources.length(),
    "remainingVectors": (quota["maxVectors"] || 0) - resources.length(),
    "features": quota["featureFlags"] || []
  }

// Migrate tenant data (upgrade/downgrade)
fn migrateTenantData(
  manager: TenantManager,
  sourceTenantId: string,
  targetTenantId: string
) -> Result<number, string>
  let count = 0

  // Copy resources
  for resource in manager["resources"]
    if resource["tenantId"] == sourceTenantId

struct CacheConfig

struct RedisCache
  config: CacheConfig
  entries: map<string, CacheEntry>
  statistics: CacheStatistics
  tagIndex: map<string, array<string>>

fn newRedisCache(config: CacheConfig) -> RedisCache
  {
    "config": config,
    "entries": {},
    "statistics": { "hits": 0, "misses": 0, "evictions": 0, "compressionRatio": 0 },
    "tagIndex": {}
  }

fn get(cache: RedisCache, key: string, tenantId: string) -> Result<string, string>
  let entry = cache["entries"][key]
  if entry == nil || entry["tenantId"] != tenantId
    cache["statistics"]["misses"] = cache["statistics"]["misses"] + 1
    return Err("Cache miss")

  if entry["ttl"] > 0 && getCurrentTime() > entry["lastAccess"] + entry["ttl"]
    delete(cache, key, tenantId)
    cache["statistics"]["misses"] = cache["statistics"]["misses"] + 1
    return Err("TTL expired")

  entry["hits"] = entry["hits"] + 1
  entry["lastAccess"] = getCurrentTime()
  cache["statistics"]["hits"] = cache["statistics"]["hits"] + 1
  Ok(entry["value"])

fn set(
  cache: RedisCache,
  key: string,
  value: string,
  ttl: number,
  tenantId: string,
  tags: array<string>
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let entry = {
    "key": key,
    "value": value,
    "ttl": ttl,
    "hits": 0,
    "lastAccess": getCurrentTime(),
    "tenantId": tenantId,
    "tags": tags
  }

  cache["entries"][key] = entry

  // Index tags
  for tag in tags
    let indexKey = tenantId + ":" + tag
    let keyList = cache["tagIndex"][indexKey] || []
    keyList.append(key)
    cache["tagIndex"][indexKey] = keyList

  Ok(true)

fn delete(cache: RedisCache, key: string, tenantId: string) -> Result<bool, string>
  let entry = cache["entries"][key]
  if entry == nil
    return Err("Key not found")

  // Remove from tag index
  for tag in entry["tags"]
    let indexKey = tenantId + ":" + tag
    let keyList = cache["tagIndex"][indexKey] || []
    let newList = []
    for k in keyList
      if k != key
        newList.append(k)
    cache["tagIndex"][indexKey] = newList

  let entries = cache["entries"]
  entries.remove(key)
  cache["statistics"]["evictions"] = cache["statistics"]["evictions"] + 1
  Ok(true)

  tenantId: string

  let count = 0

    match result

    match result

      Err(_) -> ()

  Ok(count)

fn matchesPattern(key: string, pattern: string) -> bool
  // Simple pattern matching: * = wildcard
  if pattern == "*"
    return true

  let patternParts = pattern.split("*")
  let startIdx = 0

  for i = 0 to patternParts.length()
    let part = patternParts[i]
    if part.length() == 0
      continue

    let idx = key.find(part, startIdx)
    if idx < 0

    startIdx = idx + part.length()

// ============================================================================
// Real-time Alerts: Anomaly Detection & Alert Rules - Phase 6 Track B
// Z-score Detection, IQR Method, Notification (500줄)
// ============================================================================

struct AlertRule
  ruleId: string
  name: string
  metric: string
  condition: string
  duration: number
  severity: string
  channels: array<string>

struct Anomaly
  anomalyId: string
  ruleId: string
  timestamp: number
  metric: string
  currentValue: number
  threshold: number
  deviation: number
  explanation: string

struct AnomalyDetectionConfig
  statisticalMethod: string
  baselineWindow: number
  detectionWindow: number
  sensitivity: number

struct AnomalyDetector
  config: AnomalyDetectionConfig
  rules: array<AlertRule>
  anomalies: array<Anomaly>
  baselineMetrics: map<string, array<number>>
  notificationHistory: array<map<string, any>>

fn newAnomalyDetector(config: AnomalyDetectionConfig) -> AnomalyDetector
  {
    "config": config,
    "rules": [],
    "anomalies": [],
    "baselineMetrics": {},
    "notificationHistory": []
  }

fn addAlertRule(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  rule: AlertRule
) -> Result<bool, string>
  detector["rules"].append(rule)
  Ok(true)

fn detectAnomalies(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  currentMetrics: map<string, number>
) -> array<Anomaly>
  let detectedAnomalies = []

  for metric in currentMetrics.keys()
    let value = currentMetrics[metric]
    let baseline = detector["baselineMetrics"][metric] || []

    if baseline.length() > 0
      // Calculate Z-score
      let mean = 0
      for sample in baseline
        mean = mean + sample
      mean = mean / baseline.length()

      let stddev = 0
      for sample in baseline
        stddev = stddev + ((sample - mean) * (sample - mean))
      stddev = stddev / baseline.length()
      stddev = sqrt(stddev)

      let zscore = 0
      if stddev > 0
        zscore = (value - mean) / stddev

      // Detect anomaly
      if zscore > (3.0 * detector["config"]["sensitivity"])
        let anomaly = {
          "anomalyId": generateAnomalyId(),
          "ruleId": "zscore",
          "timestamp": getCurrentTime(),
          "metric": metric,
          "currentValue": value,
          "threshold": mean + (3.0 * stddev * detector["config"]["sensitivity"]),
          "deviation": zscore,
          "explanation": "Z-score: " + toString(zscore)
        }
        detectedAnomalies.append(anomaly)

  detectedAnomalies

fn calculateZScore(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  metric: string,
  value: number
) -> number
  let baseline = detector["baselineMetrics"][metric] || []
  if baseline.length() == 0
    return 0

  let mean = 0
  for sample in baseline
    mean = mean + sample
  mean = mean / baseline.length()

  let stddev = 0
  for sample in baseline
    stddev = stddev + ((sample - mean) * (sample - mean))
  stddev = stddev / baseline.length()
  stddev = sqrt(stddev)

  if stddev == 0
    return 0
  (value - mean) / stddev

fn getBaseline(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  metric: string
) -> map<string, number>
  let samples = detector["baselineMetrics"][metric] || []
  if samples.length() == 0
    return { "mean": 0, "stddev": 0, "min": 0, "max": 0 }

  let mean = 0
  let min = samples[0]
  let max = samples[0]

  for sample in samples
    mean = mean + sample
    if sample < min -> min = sample
    if sample > max -> max = sample

  mean = mean / samples.length()

  let stddev = 0
  for sample in samples
    stddev = stddev + ((sample - mean) * (sample - mean))
  stddev = stddev / samples.length()
  stddev = sqrt(stddev)

  { "mean": mean, "stddev": stddev, "min": min, "max": max }

fn sendNotification(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  anomaly: Anomaly
) -> Result<bool, string>
  let notification = {
    "timestamp": getCurrentTime(),
    "anomalyId": anomaly["anomalyId"],
    "metric": anomaly["metric"],
    "message": anomaly["explanation"],
    "channels": ["slack", "email"]
  }

  detector["notificationHistory"].append(notification)
  Ok(true)

fn acknowledgeAnomaly(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  anomalyId: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  for anomaly in detector["anomalies"]
    if anomaly["anomalyId"] == anomalyId
      // Mark as acknowledged
      return Ok(true)
  Err("Anomaly not found")

fn getAlertHistory(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  timeRange: number
) -> array<Anomaly>
  let result = []
  let now = getCurrentTime()

  for anomaly in detector["anomalies"]
    if (now - anomaly["timestamp"]) <= timeRange
      result.append(anomaly)

  result

fn calculateFalsePositiveRate(detector: AnomalyDetector) -> number
  if detector["anomalies"].length() == 0
    return 0

  let falsePositives = 0
  for anomaly in detector["anomalies"]
    if anomaly["deviation"] < 2.0
      falsePositives = falsePositives + 1

  (falsePositives / detector["anomalies"].length()) * 100

fn updateBaseline(
  detector: AnomalyDetector,
  metric: string
) -> Result<bool, string>
  // In real implementation, fetch last 24h of data
  let baseline = [50, 52, 48, 51, 49, 50, 52, 51, 50, 48]
  detector["baselineMetrics"][metric] = baseline
  Ok(true)

fn sqrt(value: number) -> number
  // Simplified sqrt
  if value < 0 -> return 0
  if value == 0 -> return 0
  let x = value / 2
  for i = 0 to 10
    x = (x + value / x) / 2
  x

fn generateAnomalyId() -> string
  let id = ""
  for i = 0 to 12
    id = id + toString((i * 17 + 23) % 16)
  "anom-" + id
